senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.<cite ref="E00336"><he>הֵיגֶה</he></cite>. Targ. II Esth. II, 7 (translating <cite ref="N01004"><he>נעצוץ</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 55:13">Is. LV, 13</cite>, some ed. <he>הֵיגֵי׳</he>).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 110b">Sabb. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>חרגוגא דהי׳ רומיתא</he> a thistle growing among Roman thorns (prob. Corduelis spinosa, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Acantha and succeed. wds.)—Pl. <he>הֵיגֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 83b:4">B. Bath. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ רומייתא</he> (Ms. H. <he>היגא רומיתא</he>).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:19">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>מנקפי ה׳</he> (Rashi a. Ms. M. <cite ref="E00334"><he>הִיגֶא</he></cite>) those who trim thorns (collecting the twigs for themselves).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47b:8">Ab. Zar. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>דגדיר ליה בהיזמי והיגי</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <cite ref="E00448"><he>הינגי</he></cite>) he makes a fence by means of thorns and shrubs; a. fr.
